error.not_available_body: It may still be saving. Give it a moment, then try again.
error.generic_body: This object couldn't be opened. Go back to your objects and try again.

title: Objects
hint: Manage the images your stories reference. Add metadata, verify IIIF tiles, and import external sources.
empty_description: Your objects library is empty. Sync from your repo to import existing objects, or add an external IIIF object manually.
site_id_shared: Your site reads this object and {{others}} as one object, because it ignores an image extension such as .jpg at the end of an ID. On the object's page and in every step that names any of them, your site shows {{shown}}. Change the ID of one of them, or delete the one you don't want to keep.
field_title_help: The name of this object as it will appear on your published site.
field_creator_help: The person or organization that created the original object.
field_description_help: A brief description of the object, shown on the objects page of your published site.
field_period_help: The historical period this object belongs to (e.g. "Colonial period", "19th century").
field_year_help: In YYYY format — for filtering and sorting chronologically.
field_object_type_help: The medium, genre, or format of this object (e.g. "Map", "Photograph", "Engraving", "Audio recording", "Video").
field_subjects_help: Topics or themes related to this object, separated by commas.
field_source_help: The repository, archive, or collection where this object is held.
field_credit_help: Attribution line shown on the published site (e.g. "Courtesy of UCSB Library").
field_alt_text_placeholder: Describe what this object shows or contains...
custom_fields_help: These are the custom columns of your objects sheet. This object's page on your published site shows the ones that hold a value for it, labelled with the column's name.
field_alt_text_help: Describe this object for visitors using screen readers. Good descriptions mention the subject, action, and important details. For images, avoid phrases like "Image of" — screen readers already announce it as an image. For audio or video, describe what the recording contains. Example: "Hand-drawn map of a coastal town with ships in the harbor and mountains in the background."
sync_description: Check the changes you would like to sync (pull) from GitHub.
sync_new_hint: These objects were added on GitHub. An object you untick isn't added to the Compositor, and the Compositor removes it from your site's files the next time it saves your objects.
sync_order_changed: The order of your objects changed on GitHub.
sync_no_changes: No changes detected. Your objects are up to date.
sync_missing_warning: These objects exist in the Compositor but not in the repo. They may have been deleted from {{file}}.
sync_missing_used_one: One step uses this object and will be left without it:
sync_missing_used_other: {{count}} steps use this object and will be left without it:
sync_unregistered_hint: These image files are in the objects folder but not yet listed on this Compositor or the project spreadsheets. Register them to add metadata.
add_iiif_error_fetch: Could not reach the manifest URL. Check the URL and try again.
add_iiif_error_invalid: The URL does not point to a valid IIIF manifest.
add_iiif_error_parse: The manifest could not be parsed. It may use an unsupported format.
external_url_placeholder: Paste a YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive, or audio link
external_unrecognised: Link not recognized yet — paste a YouTube, Vimeo, Google Drive, or audio URL
filter_placeholder: Filter by title, creator, year, or ID
viewer_tiles_unavailable: IIIF tiles have not been generated for this object yet. Rebuild the site to create them.
delete_description: Are you sure you want to delete '{{title}}'?
delete_failed: We couldn't confirm that the object was deleted. If it was, it will disappear from the Compositor shortly. If it's still here in a few minutes, try again.
delete_stale_head: Your repository changed while the object was being deleted, so nothing was deleted. Try again.
delete_forbidden_compositor: You can only remove objects you created.
delete_forbidden_repo: Only the convenor can delete an object from the repository.
delete_document_pending: The object was deleted from the repository. It will disappear from the Compositor in a moment.
delete_compositor_pending: We're still removing the object from the Compositor. It will disappear in a moment.
delete_operation_in_progress: A publish, upgrade or upload is running on this site. You can delete this object once it has finished.
staleHeadError: The repository has changed since your last sync. Please re-sync before saving.
commitFailed: Saving to GitHub failed. Your changes were not committed — try again.
sheetsWarning: Google Sheets is currently enabled for this site. Saving will disable it so the build uses your Compositor data instead.
sheetsReversible: You can switch back to Google Sheets at any time by setting enabled: true under google_sheets in your site's _config.yml.
buildQueued: Build queued — waiting for GitHub Actions...
objectSavedHint: The file has been committed to your repository. A site rebuild is needed to generate the IIIF tiles — you can trigger one from the object's detail page.
buildFailed: Build failed. Check GitHub Actions for details.
commitModal.description: To register {{count}} new object(s) we need to update your site's {{file}} on GitHub. This will trigger a build and produce the IIIF tiles you need to work with these objects in the Compositor.
commitModal.checkFailed: We couldn't check your site's settings on GitHub, so we can't register these objects yet. We'll keep trying, or you can try again now.
commitModal.urlMismatch: Your site's URL in _config.yml doesn't match your GitHub Pages deployment.
commitModal.urlFix: We'll correct this automatically so the IIIF tiles work properly.
commitModal.insertFailedBody: Your files are safely committed to your site's repository, but registering them in the Compositor failed. Retrying is safe — nothing will be duplicated.
commitModal.addedBuildUnfinishedHeading: Your objects were added, but the site build did not finish
commitModal.addedBuildUnfinishedBody: The images are saved in your repository. They will be ready to view after your site builds successfully.
upload_drop_hint: {{formats}} — up to 25 MB each, 10 files max
upload_object_id_help: Auto-generated from filename. You can edit it.
upload_alt_help: Describes this object for screen readers
upload_disabled_upgrade_awaits_convenor: Uploading files needs a Telar upgrade first. The upgrade needs a GitHub App permission, and only the site's convenor can accept it. Ask them to upgrade the site.
upload_disabled_upgrade_required: Uploading files needs a Telar upgrade first, because each upload rebuilds your site.
repo_write_release_unknown: We couldn't check which Telar release is the latest, so we can't save this change to GitHub for now. Try again in a moment.
repo_write_upgrade_required: Saving this change to GitHub needs a Telar upgrade first, because it rebuilds your site.
repo_write_upgrade_awaits_convenor: Saving this change to GitHub needs a Telar upgrade first. The upgrade needs a GitHub App permission, and only the site's convenor can accept it. Ask them to upgrade the site.
upload_error_size: File must be 25 MB or smaller
upload_error_generic: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
upload_error_stale: The repo has changed. Sync and try again.
upload_error_operation_in_progress: A publish, upgrade or another upload is running on this site. You can add objects once it has finished.
upload_error_payload: File too large for GitHub. Try a smaller file.
upload_error_missing_data: Something went wrong preparing the upload. Close the dialog and try again.
upload_error_invalid_id: The object ID can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
upload_error_no_project: No active project found. Reload the page and try again.
upload_error_forbidden: Only the project convenor can upload files.
sync_error_toast: Sync failed. Check your repository on GitHub and try again.
sync_error_colliding_columns: The sheet "{{sheet}}" has columns Telar reads as one ({{columns}}), and each of them has values. Telar can't build the site from a sheet like this, so nothing was synced. Keep only the column you want, delete the others from the sheet on GitHub or in Google Sheets, and then sync again.
sync_error_sheet_unreadable: We couldn't read the sheet "{{sheet}}" from GitHub, so nothing was synced. Try again in a moment.
sync_stale: GitHub changed while you were reviewing the differences, so we didn't apply what you selected. These are the latest changes.
sync_not_added: Some objects from GitHub could not be added. Sync again to add them.
sync_entries_refused: The Compositor couldn't apply these changes, so nothing was changed. This is a problem in the Compositor, not in your site: please use Report a problem so we can fix it.
sync_read_not_recorded: Your changes were applied, but the site changed while they were being saved. Sync again to review what is left.
sync_changed_none_applied: Some objects were edited in the Compositor while you were reviewing them, so none of your changes were applied. Sync again to review them.
upload_dismiss_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to close?
upload_id_collision_hint: This ID already exists — the server will generate a unique one.
upload_error_too_many: Too many files — you can add up to {{max}} more
viewer_viewfinder_hint: The step captures what is inside the frame
course_item_delete_refused: Course items can't be deleted while this site is part of a course.
rename_description: Telar renames the object's files in your repository and updates every step that shows it, in one save. Your site then rebuilds its images under the new ID, which can take a few minutes.
rename_steps_one: {{count}} step shows this object and will be updated.
rename_steps_other: {{count}} steps show this object and will be updated.
rename_steps_switched_one: {{count}} step names this object but shows {{shown}}, because your site reads both as one object. After the change, it shows this object.
rename_steps_switched_other: {{count}} steps name this object but show {{shown}}, because your site reads both as one object. After the change, they show this object.
rename_steps_gained_one: {{count}} step names this object but shows no object now. After the change, it shows this object.
rename_steps_gained_other: {{count}} steps name this object but show no object now. After the change, they show this object.
rename_steps_kept_one: {{count}} step shows this object through a value your site also reads as {{after}}. It keeps its value, so after the change it shows {{after}}.
rename_steps_kept_other: {{count}} steps show this object through values your site also reads as {{after}}. They keep their values, so after the change they show {{after}}.
rename_steps_taken_over_one: {{count}} step names an object your site would read as {{id}}, and shows no object now. After the change, it shows this object.
rename_steps_taken_over_other: {{count}} steps name an object your site would read as {{id}}, and show no object now. After the change, they show this object.
rename_shared_image: Your site reads this object and {{others}} as one, so they share an image file. Telar keeps that file for {{others}} and gives this object a copy under its new ID. Images in your texts that point to the shared file stay as they are.
rename_texts: Images in your story panels, pages and glossary that point to this object's files by their exact file name are updated too. Other references, such as a link to the object's old page or an image named in a different form, stay as they are and may stop working.
rename_page_address: The object's page moves to a new address, so links to the old address from outside your site will stop working.
rename_forbidden: Only the site's convenor or the person who added this object can change its ID.
rename_taken: Another object already uses the ID {{id}}. Choose a different ID.
rename_site_taken: Your site would read {{id}} as the same object as {{other}}, because it ignores an image extension such as .jpg and the difference between capital and lowercase letters. Choose a different ID.
rename_file_exists: Your repository already has a file named {{file}} in its objects folder. Choose a different ID.
rename_id_unreadable: Your site's version of Telar would read {{id}} as an empty cell or a number and lose the object. Choose a different ID, or upgrade your site to the latest Telar release first.
rename_unchanged: This object already has that ID, so nothing was changed.
rename_stale_object: This object's ID changed after this page loaded, so nothing was changed. Reload the page to see its current ID, then try again.
rename_facts_changed: Your repository changed after you opened this page, so the steps listed above have been updated. Check them, then confirm again.
rename_stale_head: Your repository changed while Telar was renaming this object, so nothing was saved. Try again.
rename_operation_in_progress: Someone is publishing or saving objects right now. Try again in a minute.
rename_failed: Telar couldn't confirm the new ID was saved to your repository. Reload the page to see which ID the object has.
rename_document_pending: Your repository has the new ID. The Compositor will show it once it finishes updating, usually within a minute.
rename_cache_unreachable: Telar couldn't reach your site's builds on GitHub, so nothing was changed. Try again in a few minutes.
rename_unregistered_files: Your repository has image files for this object, but your objects sheet has no row for it. On the Objects tab, use the Sync from GitHub button first, then change the ID.
rename_too_many_files: Changing this ID means reading {{count}} files from your repository, and Telar can read at most {{limit}} at once, so nothing was changed. The Compositor can't change an object's ID on a site this large yet.
rename_sheets_on: Your site reads its content from Google Sheets, so its next build would bring the old ID back from your sheet. To change the ID, Telar switches Google Sheets off for this site in the same save, and your site then builds from your Compositor data.
rename_sheets_confirm: Switch off Google Sheets and change ID
rename_sheets_not_disableable: Telar couldn't switch Google Sheets off, because of how your site's _config.yml sets it, so nothing was changed. In your repository, set enabled: false under google_sheets in _config.yml, then try again.
course_item_rename_refused: A course item's ID can't be changed while this site is part of a course.
